sub_parameters.name: DingtalkNotice
sub_parameters.description:
Specifies whether to send alerts through DingTalk. Valid values:

- true: yes

- false: no

sub_parameters.name: EmailNotice
sub_parameters.description:
Specifies whether to send alerts by email. Valid values:

- true: yes

- false or null: no

sub_parameters.name: NoticeType
sub_parameters.description:
The type of the alert event. Valid values:

- ADDR\_ALERT: An address becomes unavailable.

- ADDR\_RESUME: An address becomes available.

- ADDR\_POOL\_GROUP\_UNAVAILABLE: An address pool group becomes unavailable.

- ADDR\_POOL\_GROUP\_AVAILABLE: An address pool group becomes available.

- ACCESS\_STRATEGY\_POOL\_GROUP\_SWITCH: A switchover occurs between the primary and secondary address pools.

- MONITOR\_NODE\_IP\_CHANGE: The IP address of a monitoring node changes.

sub_parameters.name: SmsNotice
sub_parameters.description:
Specifies whether to send alerts through text messages. Valid values:

- true: yes

- false or null: no

parameters.name: AlertGroup
parameters.description: The alert contact group. The value is a JSON-formatted \`List\<string>\`.

parameters.name: CnameType
parameters.description:
The type of the CNAME record. Valid value:

- PUBLIC: The CNAME record is used for Internet access.

parameters.name: ForceUpdate
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to forcefully update the instance. Valid values:

- true: Forcefully updates the instance without checking for conflicts.

- false or null: Does not forcefully update the instance. The system checks for conflicts before the update.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the GTM instance. To obtain the instance ID, call the [DescribeDnsGtmInstances](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describednsgtminstances?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d_0) operation.

parameters.name: InstanceName
parameters.description: The name of the instance. This parameter is required when you update the instance for the first time. It is optional for subsequent updates.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description: The language of the response. Valid values: en, zh, and ja. The default value is en.

parameters.name: PublicCnameMode
parameters.description:
The method used to access the instance over the Internet. Valid values:

- SYSTEM\_ASSIGN: The system assigns a canonical name (CNAME) record. This option is disabled.

- CUSTOM: You specify a CNAME record.

parameters.name: PublicRr
parameters.description: The hostname of the CNAME record that is used for Internet access.

parameters.name: PublicUserDomainName
parameters.description: The service domain name that is accessed over the Internet.

parameters.name: PublicZoneName
parameters.description:
The primary domain name that is used to access the instance over the Internet using a CNAME record. This parameter is required if you set PublicCnameMode to CUSTOM.

> Enter the primary domain name. Do not include the hostname specified by the PublicRr parameter.
